messages:
noah: FYI ran through the quickstart and noticed PII in dev logs again. appears when LOG_LEVEL=debug. anyone else hit this?
emily: ugh, yes. we discussed ordering before but I thought we fixed it. can you paste the line?
noah: ``2025-11-02T08:14:22.501Z DEBUG request_id=xyz user.email=dev.user@realmail.com signups=1``
raj: that looks like the autoinit/OTEL logger capturing structured fields before our express redactor runs. sequence issue: instrumentation attaches early, our middleware runs later.
emily: possible fixes: 1) default onboarding to LOG_LEVEL=info 2) scrub seeds to example.invalid addresses 3) add an OTEL LogProcessor that redacts before export 4) expose AUTOINIT_OPTS so sampleapp can disable autoinit in dev.
noah: I can do 1+2 quickly. can we short-term add an integration test that fails if any onboarding logs match email regex?
ryan: yes add a tiny grep in CI smoke for onboarding. long term, SDK should register a built-in redaction processor when AUTOINIT=true. that would make sampleapps safe by default.
telemetry-bot: Created ticket INF-901: "onboarding: redact order + PII leakage at debug level" https://tracker.internal/INF-901 :bug:
emily: assign to noah for the quick fixes, and I'll follow up with a PR to add AUTOINIT_OPTS docs and a sample showing how to register a pre-export log processor.
noah: will send PR with 1) LOG_LEVEL default to info in docker-compose, 2) seed scrub script, 3) CI grep test.
ryan: also file a follow-up RFC for standardizing the canonical request_id key (avoid collisions with fluentd transforms). we should recommend header name and attribute key in SDK docs.
noah: noted. thanks all.
